name: Lesser Eldritch Ichor
description: Adds a Lesser Eater of Worlds implicit modifier to a Body Armour, Boots, Gloves or Helmet. This replaces any existing implicit modifiers other than Searing Exarch implicit modifiers.
directions: Right click this item then left click a normal, magic or rare item to apply it. Cannot be used on Shaper, Elder or Elderslayer influenced items.
consoleDirections: X to use, then A on a normal, magic or rare item to apply it. Cannot be used on Shaper, Elder or Elderslayer influenced items.
